blocks.text: Feature engineering means improving data for better learning. It includes selecting, modifying, and creating features. Raw data is often not ready for models. Data may need cleaning and scaling. Feature engineering improves model performance. It helps highlight important information. Good features produce better predictions. This step requires an understanding of data. Feature engineering strengthens the model. Example: In predicting student marks, feature engineering might involve cleaning raw data like study hours, scaling it, and creating new features like "study hours per day" to improve model performance and make better predictions.
